name: s7-conversions
evidence: rusty_compatibility/06_Siemens_Classic_SCL/该厂商st规范/补充调查/Siemens_S7SCL_V53_official.pdf (chapter 14, conversion functions; 6.2 elementary data types)
assumptions: TIME and TOD are whole milliseconds; the S7 32-bit range (TIME up to 24 days) is not enforced and wrap-around is not simulated.
DATE values are whole days since 1990-01-01; the S7 16-bit range is not enforced.
The ENO/OK flag of S7 conversions (set to FALSE on overflow) is not modelled.
